infoPlist.NSBluetoothAlwaysUsageDescription: Diary One uses Bluetooth to discover and connect to your Diary One wearable for pairing and device control.
infoPlist.NSBluetoothPeripheralUsageDescription: Diary One uses Bluetooth to communicate with your Diary One wearable.
infoPlist.NSLocalNetworkUsageDescription: Diary One uses the local network to sync recordings from your Diary One and to reach your development cloud services on the same Wi‑Fi.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Diary One uses your photo library when you choose to save a captured original or update your profile photo.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryAddUsageDescription: Diary One saves images you choose to export to your photo library.

plugins.photosPermission: Allow Diary One to access photos you select for your profile.
Allow Diary One to save originals to your photo library.
plugins.savePhotosPermission: Allow Diary One to save originals to your photo library.
